speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what has been the feedback from stakeholders of the Kampung Admiralty project; (b) whether the Ministry has plans to expand the number of "vertical kampungs" to better prepare the nation for an ageing population; and (c) if so, when and where will these projects be undertaken.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For instance, residents indicate that they feel a strong sense of well-being and belonging to their community.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: They also experienced high satisfaction in terms of ease of mobility, maintenance and safety in their estates.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Service providers also reported that the co-location of facilities and close proximity to residents enabled them to form better partnerships with one another, especially when organising intergenerational activities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Beyond launching such integrated developments, HDB also takes a concerted approach in designing our residential spaces to encourage inter-generational bonding and bring greater convenience to our residents, for example, by co-locating childcare and eldercare facilities, where possible, in new BTO developments.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: First, clearly, there is a very strong demand for such integrated projects.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: Certainly, many of the residents in Tampines do look forward to that.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: Second, I am very glad to hear about the different community care type of housing that is being built, obviously, taking into consideration that it is not possible to build all new ones.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: What is the scope to repurpose existing flats by adding new facilities to create them into kampungs even within existing flats?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: As I mentioned, integrated kampungs like Kampung Admiralty and the upcoming Heart of Yew Tee are efforts to vertically integrate services that we think would be beneficial to our seniors, beneficial to intergenerational bonding and also beneficial to social and community partners who want to work much closer together to support our seniors.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: These kinds of developments, we have got one more coming up.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: We will look at opportunities to develop more, where possible.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And as we study the first and, of course, the upcoming Heart of Yew Tee project, we continue to glean learnings from that as we look for opportunities to try out further integrated kampung-type amenities.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Principally, they also save land by maximising the plot of land.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The Member asked about whether it is possible to repurpose existing flats.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: That has been our effort all this while.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: For seniors, there is a whole range of options – ageing in place, as I discussed earlier with Mr Liang Eng Hwa, both living in their existing flats and having monetisation options but also downsizing to a smaller flat and getting a Silver Housing Bonus.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And will continue to study what more can be done in order to make our homes more senior-friendly.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: In that regard, HDB works very closely with the Agency for Integrated Care and the community to support our seniors living in situ, living in their existing flats.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: But, already, we have in the community active ageing centres, eldercare centres that provide programming as well as some degree of care for our seniors.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And that is work that we do very closely with MOH and the Agency for Integrated Care and we will continue to see how we can further strengthen the tie-up between the social and community facility for seniors, surrounding partners and community agencies and RCs.
